context: Mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 誓い/あれだけ/家内/伯父/和室/帰れる/仕立て/籠

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの、本気で、絶対、誓い、絶対、よ、本気で、絶対、約束、絶対、守るって、絶対、約束
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart — Mom promises you, truly and absolutely, I swear it — she will keep her word.
lines.style: Soft, earnest opening. Repeating the promise like a vow, voice steady and tender. Light emphasis on the swearing. Warm maternal certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、あれだけ、絶対、頑張ったのに、絶対、テスト、絶対、ダメだったよ
lines.en: Mom — I really did try so hard, but the test just… didn't go well.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact delivery. A small boy's resigned acceptance beneath the surface. Not complaining — just stating what happened. Slight trailing off after 'well'.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、家内、絶対、安全、絶対、いつも、絶対、お祈りしてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father — he prays for our family's safety every single day, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, almost confiding tone. Warm but weighty — speaking to something Sho needs to know. Even pace, slight reverence on 'prays'. Her voice carries care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、伯父、絶対、さんの、絶対、お家、絶対、遊びに行きたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to go play at Uncle's house…
lines.style: Hopeful lilt at the end, testing the waters. Child's gentle persistence — not demanding, just wishing. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、和室、絶対、お掃除、絶対、してね
lines.en: Sho, I need you to help Grandma clean the tatami room, alright?
lines.style: Clear, kind direction. Not stern — matter-of-fact. A touch of warmth underneath the practical request. Expects compliance but doesn't demand it loudly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、もう、本気で、絶対、帰れる、絶対、よね?本気で
lines.en: Mom, I can go home now, right?
lines.style: Small boy's hopeful question, seeking permission. Leans toward the end. Genuine curiosity mixed with a touch of readiness to leave. Expectant but not impatient.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、仕立て、絶対、のいいスーツ、絶対、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, look how nicely your father's suit is tailored — so stylish.
lines.style: Warm, admiring observation. Turning his attention outward, sharing in her appreciation. Light and pleased. A small teaching moment without effort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お庭で、本気で、絶対、籠、絶対、にお花、絶対、入れたよ
lines.en: Mom, I put the flowers in the basket in the garden.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the simple accomplishment. Clear-voiced, a child sharing something he did well. Modest but pleased. Small breath before the statement.
